UI_ZS_Info: Your personal settings (stats in console.txt). Everything that must be the same for all players (on/off, smoothness, send rate, upload cap, lag-spike buffer, players, attacks, eating) is in the host's sandbox options, page ZombieSync MP; an admin can change it in a running game (Admin > Sandbox options).
UI_ZS_NotLoaded: The Java part of ZombieSync is not loaded (see ZombieBuddy); these settings take effect once it is.
UI_ZS_LogStats_tt: [ZombieSync] lines: delay, corrections, jumps, send rate. Useful when reporting a problem.
